description: Base gas sampled every 5 minutes over a lookback window (default 24h): min/max/average/median and whether gas is cheap, normal, expensive or flat right now. Costs about $0.01. Each call makes a real USDC micropayment on Base mainnet via x402 from BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY; payments above MAX_USD_PER_CALL are refused. Do not call it in loops.

hours.description: Lookback window in hours, 1 to 168. Default 24.

name: get_gas_history
title: Base gas history and verdict
